samples.scenario: Executive impersonation attack using a newly registered domain that mimics the CEO's domain but replaces a single character with a visually similar Unicode character (Latin 'o' replaced with Greek omicron). The attacker sends an urgent email requesting multiple wire transfers to offshore accounts. SPF passes due to the attacker configuring their own mail server with authorized IP, but DKIM fails as the signing domain is not aligned with the from domain. DMARC policy is set to quarantine and the email is delivered to a finance mailbox with a high spam score. The subject line uses deliberate homoglyph substitution and added invisible Unicode characters to evade filtering.
